name: launchdarkly-copilot
description: Generate correct, testable, and removable LaunchDarkly feature-flag code from GitHub Copilot — covers the Java server SDK and the TypeScript SDKs (Node server, client-side JS, React) with knowledge skills, scaffolding and flag-removal skills, and an anti-pattern review agent.
